answers.core: It's a core feature being modified.
answers.workaround: It will be used often in any platform game with slopes. It can be easily worked around by manually setting floor_max_angle to 46 degrees but it's a pain and 99% of a time it's what user wants anyway.

title: Make move_and_slide_with_snap() floor_max_angle 46 degrees instead of 45 degrees.
